# `^FH` – Field Hexadecimal Indicator

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Enable hexadecimal escape indicator for field data (default '_').

Reference parameters: **i**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 193](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
